purpose: Reference settings for calibration, protection intensity, and healthy runtime.

policies.nonfinite: NaN to zero; positive/negative infinity to upper/lower bound; finite values unchanged
policies.finite: clamp finite values to bounds; nonfinite values unchanged
policies.combined: apply both finite clipping and nonfinite repair

application.invocations: every covered prefill and decode invocation
application.order: inject first, then repair in the same forward hook before returning the output
application.matching: replay the selected fault plan across policies; protection can change the values presented to a later mutation

calibration.minmax: observe all activation values per module

sampled_quantile.value_selection: evenly spaced flattened indices via torch.linspace(...).long()
sampled_quantile.reservoir: seeded per model, dtype, task, and module
sampled_quantile.quantile_index: int(q * (n - 1)) in sorted reservoir; no interpolation

calibration.expanded_bounds: midpoint +/- scale * half_range, capped at FP16 finite limits

initial_calibration_assessment.note: Separate cohort and initial policy assessment, not pooled with the later min/max protection grid.

matched_calibration_comparison.selection_criterion: zero observed loss of initially scorer-correct answers on the healthy selection cohort
matched_calibration_comparison.cohorts: healthy selection, fault evaluation, and calibration use separate inputs

protection_intensity.reuse: draw zero of the matched-calibration 16-bit/four-bits-per-site condition, not additional replications

healthy_runtime.source_cohort: subset of the matched-calibration healthy policy-selection cohort
healthy_runtime.warmups: one generation per arm per worker, outside the timers
healthy_runtime.arm_order: deterministically interleaved within question and repetition
healthy_runtime.scope: single-worker eager-hook generation, not an optimized serving-throughput benchmark
